key_findings: Paclitaxel increases DRG macrophage infiltration, TNF-alpha/IL-1beta, and RIP3/MLKL/pMLKL in DRG neurons with necrosis and hyperalgesia.
Macrophage depletion with clodronate liposomes reversed these changes and alleviated pain behavior in PIPN rats.
